rationale: C23 plausibly supplied a compact commendation-letter template: an opening expressing delight on learning of a private organization's new public campaign, praise for activity serving the public interest, and a concluding hope for broad participation or success. The child adapts that sequence from highway safety to cancer fundraising and shares the relatively specific combination of “delighted to learn,” a campaign/program, and “public service.” C17 is close in recipient and labor context but lacks the same campaign-commendation structure; C04 has similar praise for a public effort but is substantially more operational and policy-focused.

shared_material.child_excerpt: I was delighted to learn today that the AFL-CIO and its member unions have pledged to raise $1 million
shared_material.parent_excerpt: I am delighted to learn of the new radio awards initiated by the Alfred P. Sloan Foundation
shared_material.explanation: Both begin by expressing delight upon learning that a nongovernmental organization has initiated or supported a public-benefit effort.

shared_material.child_excerpt: this special effort on behalf of the general welfare ... exemplifies again the spirit of public service
shared_material.parent_excerpt: a truly comprehensive effort on the part of the industry in this important field of public service
shared_material.explanation: Both characterize the recipient's organized initiative as an industry or institutional contribution to public service.

shared_material.child_excerpt: I wish your campaign every success.
shared_material.parent_excerpt: It is my hope, therefore, that every network and station will participate
shared_material.explanation: Each closes with a concise expression of hope for the campaign's successful or widespread implementation.
